statements.text: Workspace members who are not owners can open a trial workspace.

next_action.action: Product designer answers d-resume and d-member; then the design package is updated before engineering starts.

initial_rating.reason: Screens, states, tokens and breakpoints are specified, but resuming the guide and non-owner members are not.
initial_rating.ten_looks_like: Every promised behaviour has a visible state: the resumed guide at step 2 or 3, and what a member who cannot create projects sees.

information-architecture.gap: Primary action per step is clear; the Help entry point for reopening is named but its position in the menu is not.

interaction-states.gap: No partial (resumed) state for the guide and no permission-denied state for members who cannot create a project.

journey.gap: The reopen step promises the guide opens at the step the user left, but no screen state shows it.

responsive-accessibility.gap: Keyboard order and 44px targets are stated but marked not verified; the mobile sheet's relation to the workspace scroll is not specified.

unresolved-decisions.gap: Two decisions are open: resume behaviour and the member experience.

state_table.empty: No project yet. The guide creates your first one in three steps.
state_table.error: The project was not created: that name is already used in this workspace.
state_table.success: Project created. Next: add a first task.

state_table.empty: You have not dismissed the guide, so there is nothing to reopen.

journey.step: Lands on the empty workspace with the guide open

plan_specifies.text: No project yet. The guide creates your first one in three steps.
Project created. Next: add a first task.

journey.step: Leaves the guide and later reopens it from Help

findings.title: Resumed guide has no state
findings.problem: The brief promises the guide reopens at the step the user left, but the state table has no partial or resumed state for the guide, so engineering would invent one.
findings.recommendation: Specify the resumed guide for steps 2 and 3: heading, progress and the one action, in the existing tokens.

evidence.text: The guide opens at the step the user left.

findings.title: No state for members who cannot create a project
findings.problem: Members who are not owners can open a trial workspace; the guide's first step is creating a project, and the plan does not say what they see.
findings.recommendation: Decide whether members see the guide at all, and if they do, specify a permission-denied state with who can help.

findings.title: Mobile sheet scrolling is unspecified
findings.problem: At 0px the guide becomes a full-width sheet above the workspace; the plan does not say whether the workspace scrolls under it or is pushed down.
findings.recommendation: State the mobile sheet's scroll behaviour and its dismiss control.

evidence.text: The guide becomes a full-width sheet above the workspace

decisions.question: What does a reopened guide show?

options.label: Open at the step the user left, with progress shown

decisions.why: It is the brief's own goal and keeps the three-step promise.

decisions.question: Do members who cannot create projects see the guide?

options.label: Show a permission-denied state naming the workspace owner

decisions.why: Members still need to know why nothing is there and who can start it.

handoff.notes: Update the design package for the answered decisions, then engineering.
